t: Kamma debarim haasurim laasot beyom tob veezo mehem muttarim al yede shinnuy
s: Kamma debarim haasurim laasot beyom tob veezo mehem muttarim al yede shinnuy ubo k"a seipim: muttar limlol shibbolim shel tebua beyadayv kede sheyyippol hazzera min hashshibbolet, ap al pi shehaya epshar lo limlol meereb yom tob. Veken muttar leparek hashsharbitim shel qitniyyot beyadayv kede sheyyittaleshu hazzereonim mimmeqom chibburam bashsharbit veyotziem mittokam beyadayv. Veap al pi shehu mepareq dabar miggiddulo, veillu haya oseh ken beshabbat al yede keli hammeyuchad lekak, o shehaya mepareq hazzereonim beyadayv mimmeqom chibburam haya chayyab mishshum dash, mikkol maqom beyom tob kevan sheissur haddisha letzorek akila eno ella middibre soperim — lo gazeru ella al disha gemura shekkayyotze bah beshabbat chayyab chattat. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim, deap beyom tob lo hittiru limlol uleparek ella al yede shinnuy, dehaynu sheyyimlol viparek berashe etzbeotayv shel yado achat bilbad. Veap al pi shehaiqqar kisbara harishona, mikkol maqom im epshar lo laasot ken al yede shinnuy — tob lehachamir velachush lisbara haacharona.

Hazzereonim achar shennitpareku mehashshibbolim vaadayin hem meorabim im hammotz — muttar lenaaran miyyado haachat leyado hashshenit ulenappeach mehen hammotz. Velo yenappach harbeh beyachad, mippene shennireh kimnappeach letzorek hachol, ella menappeach meat meat veokel miyyad. Vaapillu beqanon, shehu keli sherosho echad rachab verosho hashsheni asuy kemin marzeb qatzar — muttar litten hazzereonim betok harachab ulenaanea, vehaokel mitgalgel derek hammarzeb vehappesolet nishar bakkeli. Abal lo yenappeh otam benapa ukebara, ap al pi shello haya epshar lo lenappot meereb yom tob, vaapillu eno menappeh ella meat meat veokel miyyad, mikkol maqom, kevan shebbakkelim hallalu en derek lenappot meat ella harbeh beyachad, lepikak hamnappeh bahem nireh kimnappeh leyamim rabbim.

Habborer qitniyyot hamorabim im aprurit o im motz shellahem — borer kedarko apillu pesolet mittok haokel, vaapillu beqanon, vaapillu eno okel mehem lealtar ella borer beshacharit leekol ben haarbayim. Veap al pi shekkayyotze bo beshabbat chayyab chattat apillu borer okel mittok happesolet, mikkol maqom beyom tob letzorek akila hittiru libror kedarko apillu pesolet mittok haokel. Velo ameru dehabberira hi mimmelakot haasurot beyom tob ap letzorek akila, ella bibrirat tebua, shedderek labor otah harbeh beyachad, ukemo shennitbaer besimman ttz"h, ayyen sham hattaam, abal mine qitniyyot sheen derek labor otan ella mah shetztzarik lo mehem bo bayyom — muttar libror kedarko.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehaokel merubbeh al happesolet, sheyyesh yoter torach bibrirat haokel mittok happesolet mibbibrirat happesolet mittok haokel, lepikak hitzriku oto libror happesolet kede lemaet betorach beyom tob. Abal im happesolet merubba al haokel — tzarik libror et haokel ulehanniach et happesolet, kede lemaet betorach. Veken apillu im haokel merubbeh al happesolet, ella sheyyesh yoter torach bibrirat happesolet mibberirat haokel, kegon shehappesolet hu daq meod veyesh torach liqqach oto beyado — tzarik libror haokel ulehanniach happesolet, kede lemaet betorach. Veken im happesolet merubba al haokel, ap al pi sheyyesh yoter torach bibrirat haokel mibberirat happesolet, kegon shehaokel hu daq meod — tzarik libror et haokel ulehanniach et happesolet, kevan shekkammut happesolet merubba al kammut haokel. Abal im kammut haokel hu shaveh lekammut happesolet veyesh yoter torach bibrirat haokel mibberirat happesolet — tzarik libror et happesolet mittok haokel, kede lemaet betorach. Veim haokel vehappesolet shenehem shavin bekammutan ubetirchatan — hareshut beyado libror ezo sheyyirtzeh.

Vekol zeh keshello haya epshar lo libror meereb yom tob, abal im haya epshar lo libror meereb yom tob — asur libror pesolet mittok haokel apillu beyado, ap al pi shehaokel merubbeh al happesolet veyesh yoter torach bibrirat haokel mibbibrirat happesolet. Vaapillu okel mittok happesolet en lo libror ella mah shehu tzarik leekol lealtar kemo shennitbaer besimman shy"t leinyan shabbat, lepi shekkol "meleket okel nepesh" shehaya epshar lo laasotah meereb yom tob velo yihyeh bekak hepsed velo chesron taam — asur laasotah beyom tob, mittaam shennitbaer besimman ttz"h.

Vaapillu im lo haya epshar libror meereb yom tob — asur lehanniach haqqitniyyot bemayim kede sheyyatzup happesolet lemala, o kede sheyyered haaprurit lematta, veen tzarik lomar sheasur lenappotan benapa ukebara, mittaam shebbearnu lemala.

En mesannenin et hachardal bimsannenet shello, mippene shennireh keborer, shemmashlik hassubbin shello, ap al pi sheen zeh borer mammash, shehare gam hassubbin reuyim laakila veenan niqraim pesolet, mikkol maqom, kevan shennireh keborer — asaruhu chakamim, shehare epshar lesanneno meereb yom tob. Abal im lo haya epshar lesanneno meereb yom tob — muttar lesanneno beyom tob.

Hachardal hu mar uregilin lematteqo al yede shemmekabbin betoko gachelet o eben nissoqet, ubeyom tob asur lekabbot betoko gachelet shel etz, lepi sheen kibbuy zeh tzorek "okel nepesh" mammash, sheepshar leekol basar belo chardal, veen tzarik ella limunnagim, vekol dabar sheeno shaveh lekol nepesh — asur laasoto beyom tob, kemo shennitbaer besimman tqy"a ayyen sham. Abal muttar lekabbot betoko gachelet shel matteket o eben nissoqet, lepi sheen shayyak kibbuy bematteket, sheap im lo yekabbennu lo yissarep, velo yeaseh pecham. Veap beshabbat en issur lekabboto ella middibre soperim, ubeyom tob letzorek akila lo gazeru. Umittaam zeh muttar litten shappud shel matteket melubban letok hammashqeh kede sheyyitchammetz, im hu rauy lishtoto bo bayyom.

Meshammeret shehayeta teluya veomedet meereb yom tob — muttar litten bah shemarim shel yayin lesannenan, veken shemarim shel shear mashqim tobim vachazaqim, beinyan sheim haya mesannenan meereb yom tob lo haya hammashqeh hayyotze min hashshemarim kol kak tob vechazaq kemo shehu akshav shemmesannen bo bayyom sheshshoteh oto. Abal asur litlot et hammeshammeret lekattechilla beyom tob kede lesannen bah, shello yaaseh kederek shehu oseh bechol, mishshum zilzul yom tob, shennireh kimtaqqen veqobea hammeshammeret lesannen bah yayin harbeh beqeba.

Umuttar lehaarim litlot hammeshammeret kede lehanniach betokah perot veachar kak noten bah shemarim lesannenan letzorek yom tob, vehu shennatan bah perot qodem shennatan bah shemarim, abal im noten bah shemarim qodem shennatan bah perot — nikkar haddabar shettoleh otah bishbil hashshemarim veasur.
En osin gebina beyom tob, lepi sheepshar laasotah meereb yom tob, shehaggebina yeshana toba mehachadasha.

En maamidin chalab beyom tob, dehaynu shennotenin letokah qeba lehaamido, veasur mishshum borer, shemmaprid haqqom min hechalab. Veap al pi shehi "meleket okel nepesh", mikkol maqom, kevan shedderek lehaamid harbeh chalab bebat achat, chasheshu chakamim im nattir lo lehaamid beyom tob — shemma yaamid harbeh letzorek hachol. Umittaam zeh asur laasot chema min shuman shetztzap al pene hechalab, shehare hu borer, shemmaprid hechalab min hachema shebbo. Vaapillu al yede nokri asur laasot, kedin shear issure yom tob sheasur apillu al yede nokri.

Yaraq talush sheyyesh bo rashe alin nirqabin — en gozezim otam bemisparayim shedderek lechattekam bahem mehammechubbar, mippene marit haayin, sheharoeh (et hammisparayim etzel hayyaraq) yomar shehayyom nigzezu mehammechubbar.
Muttar letaqqen et haqqundas veet haakkabiyyot, vehen mine yeraqot sheyyesh torach harbeh betiqqunan.

Muttar limloach harbeh chatikot tzenon beyachad im rotzeh leoklam achar kak bo bayyom ap al pi sheasur beshabbat, shehare im haya oseh ken meereb yom tob haya mepig taam hatztzenon. Veyesh machmirin shello limloach harbeh chatikot beyachad, kemo shennitbaer besimman shak"[a] leinyan shabbat, shehare epshar limloach kol chatika bipne atzmah, sheen haachat mashbachat bimlichat chabertah. Vetob lachush ledibrehem bedabar sheen bo hepsed kelal.

Ap al pi shehuttera hotzaa beyom tob apillu shello letzorek akila, mikkol maqom lo yissa massaot gedolot kederek shehu nose bechol, ella tzarik leshannot. Ketzad? Hammebi kadde yayin mimmaqom lemaqom — lo yolikem besal o bequppa, dehaynu shello yitten arbaa o chamishsha kaddim besal o bequppa kederek shehu oseh bechol, ella yolikem al ketepo o lepanayv echad echad o shenayim shenayim, kede sheyyehe nikkar shelletzorek yom tob hu molikem.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmolikem bemaqom shemmetzuyim bo rabbim, kegon barechobot o bimboot, abal im molikem mibbayit lebayit bechatzer achat — en tzarik leshannot kelal. Umuttar leholik harbeh kaddim bequppa achat, veadderabba yoter tob hu leholik harbeh beyachad mishsheyyolik meat meat veyitztarek leharbot behilluk, veasur litroach beyom tob tircha sheenah tzerika.
Hammolik teben bequppa lehesseq o libhema — lo yapshil et haqquppa laachorayv, lepi shehu genay yom tob, shennireh kemi shemmitkavven limlaka rabba o leholik lemaqom rachoq kederek chol.

Hannose massaot sheddarkan lissa otan bemot — yissa otan al gabbo meachorayv, vesheddarkan lissa otan al gabbo meachorayv — yissa otan al ketepo, vesheddarkan lehinnase al hakkatep — yissa otan beyado lepanayv, o yipros alehen beged im hen mashqin sheen lachush bahen shemma yabou lide sechita, kegon beyayin adom o shear mashqin sheen melabbenim, veap im yischot — eno chayyab mishshum melabben, kemo shennitbaer besimman shy"t ayyen sham.

Vekol zeh kesheepshar lo leshannot, abal im i epshar lo leshannot, kegon shezzimmen orechim vetzarik lemaher ulehabi lipnehem, ap al pi shehaorechim hen meotah hair sheen kan mitzvat haknasat orechim, mikkol maqom, kevan shehu nechpaz vetzarik lemaher — eno tzarik laasot shum shinnuy midderek hachol, umuttar leholik harbeh kaddim besal ubequppa ulehapshilam laachorayv.
En mebiin etzim kerukim bechebel velo bemachatzelet velo bequppa, abal mebiin kerukim bemitpachat o becheqo.
